statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band while NQ is closed for the weekend.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the main conditional risk concentration is the Sunday Globex reopening.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low; geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: NQ is closed, so weekend geopolitical and energy developments cannot establish a persistent Nasdaq price path. Friday ended with two-sided gains. Iran-sanctions and Strait of Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme, while conditional Tail rises only around the Sunday futures reopening.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 published hourly assessments remained EA_ON with Tail at 16%. Stress increased from 96% to 97% as weekend geopolitical risk intensified, while dominantMode remained normal during the NQ closure.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of the weekend closure, rises to WATCH into the Sunday Globex reopening, and conditionally decays if early price discovery is two-sided. Monday's Chicago Fed releases are the next scheduled U.S. checkpoints inside this 24-hour horizon.
